items.title: Ladd McConkey: Deemed day-to-day by Harbaugh
items.text:
Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh noted Monday that McConkey is viewed as "day to day" with back spasms, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

items.title: Justin Herbert: Avoids fractured finger, per coach
items.text:
Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh relayed Monday that Herbert (finger) avoided a fracture in his left middle finger,  Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.
